title: Page frontmatter
description: A page's type sets the section it is listed in and the fields it carries. Its title is its first heading, and its sources are the files its footnotes link to.

type.description: The kind of page. A project is one component of Steading; a topic is anything else.

summary.description: One sentence for listings, restating what the page's body says and cites.

status.description: Where a project stands. concept: designed, not built. active: built, and in use. dormant: built, with no active work. The page's Status section states it with a citation.

repository.description: The GitHub repository that holds a project, as owner/name.
